  • 构造器详细资料

    • AdminApplicationRecord

      public AdminApplicationRecord(String appId, String name, String jobId, String moId, String taId, String major, String intro, String skills, String email, String cvPath, String appStatus)
      Creates an immutable application record except for the mutable application status.
      参数:
      appId - unique application identifier
      name - applicant name
      jobId - applied job identifier
      moId - module organizer identifier
      taId - teaching assistant identifier
      major - applicant major
      intro - applicant introduction
      skills - applicant skills
      email - applicant email address
      cvPath - path to the submitted CV
      appStatus - current application status
